entities.summary: Nazokat Anvarovna Kasimova is an Uzbek political scientist, Doctor of Political Science, professor, a leading expert of Uzbekistan on international systems and political issues of global development, regional integration, and regional security, as well as a national expert on higher education reform in Uzbekistan.
